other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: Provisions similar to those comprising this section were contained in a prior section 5275(3), act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 651 , prior to the general revision of this chapter by Pub. L. 85–859.
